title: Z-Image Turbo
description: Local text-to-image generation from the official Z-Image Turbo workflow. Creation only, not Z-Image-Edit. Graph and software contracts are checked; local output quality and speed have not been qualified.

evidence: Adapted official Comfy-Org workflow_templates at e7cd011d4ded3411c2f481200544f0be6fdc962e; source SHA-256 baaf937ff071970cc6b1e2fa0093a4dd664a4cc734d38adc4c7810e535c1f1d3.
Retains the official 8-step, CFG 1, res_multistep/simple, shift 3 defaults; no negative-prompt or image-edit control.
Creation-only route; no local generation, model loading, speed or image-quality qualification performed. Node and filename readiness is not a verification of installed weight hashes.
